items.title: Messer Featured on Conference’s “All-American” Show

items.title: Countdown to Kickoff: Game 8 at North Texas
items.summary: DENTON, Texas — Florida Atlantic football is on the ESPN flagship station for a Thursday night matchup, facing North Texas on the road, Oct. 29. Kickoff at DATCU Stadium is at 7:30 p.m. ET.

items.title: University Press staff predict a high scoring Thursday night clash against North Texas

items.title: Messer Named National Paul Hornung Player of the Week
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Following his historic five-touchdown performance in a 51-49 victory over Rice, Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer has been selected by the National College Football Awards Association as the Paul Hornung Award National Player of the Week, announced Tuesday afternoon by the Louisville Sports Commission.

items.title: Messer Earns Walk-On of the Week Honor
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – On the heels of 262 all-purpose yards and five touchdowns in one game, Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer has been selected as the Burlsworth Trophy Walk-On of the Week, announced on Tuesday.

items.title: Football Game Notes #8
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football will head back on the road on a short week for the first of two consecutive Thursday night games, both nationally televised. First up is North Texas in Denton, with kickoff set for 7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.

items.title: Florida Atlantic Hosts UTSA on ESPN
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football will air on the ESPN flagship station for the second time in as many weeks, hosting UTSA on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium, Thursday, Nov. 5. Kickoff is now scheduled for 7:30 p.m., moved up 30 minutes from its previously announced time.

items.title: American Offensive Player of the Week Goes to Messer
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – A performance for the ages from fifth-year WR Easton Messer, that saw him tie Florida Atlantic football's single-game touchdown record, earned him American Conference Offensive Player of the Week as announced by the league on Monday.

items.title: Weekly Coaches Show Moves to Tuesday and Features Special Guest
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. - The Florida Atlantic Coaches Show, presented by Duffy's Sports Grill, moves to Tuesday for the next two weeks (Oct. 27 and Nov. 3). The show takes place from 6 to 7 p.m. at the Duffy's Sports Grill on St. Andrew's Boulevard in Boca Raton.

items.summary: Florida Atlantic football (5-2, 2-1 AC) made their homecoming game one to remember as they defeated Rice University (1-7, 0-4 AC) in the Battle of the Owls 51-49, in a game that came down to the wire. items.title: Messer’s Five Touchdowns Lead Owls to Nail-Biting Homecoming Win
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Five touchdowns from fifth-year WR Easton Messer, tying the single-game program record, led Florida Atlantic football to a 51-49 barnburner victory over Rice on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium.

items.title: Florida Atlantic at North Texas to Air on ESPN
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – For the first time since 2020, a live Florida Atlantic football game will air on the main ESPN channel. The Owls' (4-2, 1-1) matchup at North Texas on Thursday, Oct. 29 has been designated for ESPN with kickoff set for 7:30 p.m ET., announced by the American Conference.
